_comment: Cross-language SSoT for MAC canonicalization. Three implementations agree on this
table or a build fails: virtusphere_normalize_mac() (lib/mac.php), ConvertTo-VsNormalizedMac
Why this file exists: the portal writes the MAC, MECM looks it up by exact match.
A canonicalization that drifts on one side makes a VM invisible to MECM with no error
(TESTPLAN finding 2.2, P1). PHPUnit MacNormalizeTest and Pester Mac.Tests.ps1 both read
this table, so the two languages cannot drift apart silently.
expected: null means 'not a MAC address' (the caller must reject the value).
Separators are stripped, not validated: any non-hex byte is a separator. That is
deliberate and shared - both sides do it, and this table pins that they keep doing it.

vectors.why: hyphen form printed by Windows ipconfig /all
no hex payload of the right length
non-hex letters do not become a MAC
single bad nibble drops it below 12 hex
